subject: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Hi Sarah 1 thanks again for your time earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of needs / pain points you called out:
- Latency-sensitive chat & assistant flows for customer support (95th percentile target < 300ms).
- Need for deterministic structured outputs for downstream automation (JSON schema for ticket updates).
- Higher-quality semantic search across docs: embeddings + reranking to de-dup and boost relevance.
- Integration constraints: must support function-calling patterns and streaming partial responses; security: SSO + SOC2 evidence.

What Redwood can provide (high level):
- SDK (v1.4) with first-class function-calling helpers and structured output schema validation.
- Streaming responses that emit tokens + chunked events to update UI immediately while preserving final structured JSON output.
- Embeddings pipeline + dedicated reranking endpoint to post-process top-k candidates.
- Private deployment / Dedicated options if you need isolation; we can provide SOC2 artifacts (we discussed what you need).

Proposed next steps / timeline:
1) Share an integration design doc and POC timeline (attached) 1 we propose a 4-week technical POC starting the week of Apr 26.
2) Vivek to lead a short technical kickoff with your ML infra (30 45m) to go over SDK changes and function-calling signatures.
3) Neha to share SOC2 and SSO onboarding steps and a list of required artifacts.
4) Marissa to follow up with pricing/POC commitment and success criteria.

Attachments: redwood_integration_design_v1.pdf (integration proposal), acme_poc_timeline.xlsx (proposed timeline & milestones).

If that all looks right, can we lock in a technical kickoff the week of Apr 26? I can send a 30m invite for Tue/Wed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime for production LLMs

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme ML Team <ml-team@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect and captures the call. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Latency: the < 300ms p95 target is for our primary support flow (max ~1.5k active sessions). We'll need to verify batching behavior for concurrent sessions.
- Structured outputs: we need a JSON schema that maps to our ticketing system (Zendesk) and a way to validate before we call the ticket API.
- Embeddings/reranking: we'll want to compare Redwood embeddings against our current FAISS baseline; can the reranker accept external embedding vectors?
- Security: thanks — please include an updated SOC2 inventory and network diagram. We'll share our internal security questionnaire after the kickoff.

Availability for kickoff: Tue Apr 27 10am PT or Wed Apr 28 2pm PT work for the ML infra team. We prefer Tue if possible.

One ask: can Vivek include a short note on SDK changes required on our side (token handling, streaming client, and function-calling handlers) so our engineers can pre-read?

Sarah
VP Product — Assistant & Automation | Acme Corp
sarah.patel@acme.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps (technical kickoff notes)

Thanks — quick tech note before the kickoff that I promised to send. High-level SDK/engineering considerations (so your team can prep):

1) SDK version & breaking changes
- Redwood SDK v1.4 includes a new function-calling helper that serializes function signatures into the model prompt and returns a structured "function_call" object. Backwards compatible with v1.x but we recommend upgrading for deterministic outputs.

2) Streaming model responses
- We support SSE/WS streaming. Client should be able to handle incremental partials and a final "structured_output" event containing the validated JSON. We recommend implementing a short debounce (50–100ms) to avoid UI thrash on very chatty agents.

3) Embeddings & reranking
- Reranker endpoint accepts either Redwood-generated embeddings or externally computed vectors (we accept a 768/1024 float vector per item). We'll include a short sample script for using FAISS outputs against our reranker.

4) Function calling & ticketing
- Schema validation is built into the SDK; the client can call validate(schema, payload) and receive a report of missing/typed fields before making the outbound call to Zendesk.

5) Auth & security
- For the POC we'll provision short-lived API keys and support mTLS if you need it. For Dedicated/Private we can integrate with your IdP (SAML/SCIM) for SSO.

I'll bring a short deck and the SDK upgrade checklist to the kickoff. Attaching a very short agenda and the initial integration diagram.

Attachments: redwood_integration_design_v1.pdf


Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Great — locking in Tue Apr 27 10:00am PT for the technical kickoff (invite sent).

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marissa: finalize POC success criteria + pricing proposal (due Apr 16)
- Vivek: provide SDK pre-read + short demo deck (due Apr 23)
- Neha: share SOC2 inventory and SSO onboarding checklist (due Apr 23)
- Acme (Sarah): confirm internal participants for kickoff and share security questionnaire (due Apr 23)

POC success criteria (draft) — please review:
1) p95 latency < 300ms for support flow under 1.5k concurrent sessions (measured via Redwood dashboard)
2) Structured output accuracy: <= 5% invalid schema cases on production prompt set
3) Search relevance: +10 NDCG@10 vs current baseline in reranker evaluation

If you want anything changed in the agenda or add an SRE/infra attendee to the kickoff, reply here and I'll update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa
